svg.title: Backend Architecture Playground infrastructure topology
svg.desc: Readable infrastructure diagram showing client and test tools flowing through HAProxy, API replicas, Redis cache and rate limiting, PgBouncer, Postgres tables, transactional outbox, RabbitMQ queues, worker processing, retry and DLQ, migrations, seed data, and observability.
svg.text: A single topology view for request routing, cache HIT/MISS, DB pooling, transactional outbox, queues, retries, workers, migrations, load tools, and observability.

source of truth, migration records, durable outbox, worker idempotency
